title: Dense orbits for scale-invariant rotationally symmetric solutions of the 2D Euler equations
summary: Let $m \ge 4$. We prove that there is a forward orbit of the 2D Euler system for scale-invariant $m$-fold symmetric vorticities, namely \begin{equation*} \partial_tg + 2G\partial_θg = 0, \quad 4G + \partial_{θθ}G = g, \end{equation*} which is dense in $S :=\{g \in L_{m,\mathrm{odd}}^\infty(\mathbb{S}^1): g\sin(mθ) \ge 0 \text{ and }\|g\|_{L^\infty} \le 1\}$ equipped with the topology of weak$^*$ convergence on $L^\infty(\mathbb{S}^1)$, where $L_{m,\mathrm{odd}}^\infty(\mathbb{S}^1)$ denotes the space of odd and $m$-fold symmetric functions in $L^\infty(\mathbb{S}^1)$.
